crossRefs.note: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon…
They went up and encamped in Kiriath Jearim in Judah. Therefore they call that place Mahaneh Dan to this day. Behold…
So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor the brook of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring…
David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there…
so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,
“But go now to my place which was in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it for…
therefore I will do to the house which is called by my name, in which you trust, and to the place which I gave to you…

people.name: Kiriath-jearim
people.line: A city where the ark resided

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: They sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath Jearim, saying, “The Philistines have brought back Yahweh’s ark. Come down and bring it up to yourselves.”
translations.bsb: So they sent messengers to the people of Kiriath-jearim, saying, “The Philistines have returned the ark of the LORD. Come down and take it up with you.”
translations.kjv: And they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kirjathjearim, saying, The Philistines have brought again the ark of the LORD; come ye down, and fetch it up to you.
translations.asv: And they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath-jearim, saying, The Philistines have brought back the ark of Jehovah; come ye down, and fetch it up to you.
